name: ScanResultsDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ScanResultsDashboard
summary: A scan results dashboard: items sent for analysis, the verdict each one received and what is still waiting. A page heading with a Refresh IconButton sits over a row of six StatTiles (submitted, in analysis, last 24 hours, flagged, held for a verdict and open alerts), each with a Hint that defines it. Below, three cards share a row: a DonutChart of the verdicts (Clean, Suspicious, Flagged and Pending, in their status hues) with the item count in its center, a BarList of the sources the items came from, and a Card that sums up the deliveries held for a verdict and the items delivered before they were flagged, each with a Link to its list. A Submissions card across the full width holds the filter row (an Input search and Selects for status, verdict and source) over a paginated TableRoot: name, the verdict Tag, category, score, type, size, source, first submitter and last seen. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `DonutChart`, `BarList`, `ChartCard`, `Card`, `TableRoot`, `Table.CellStatus`, `Link`, `Input`, `Select`, `Hint`, `IconButton`, `Skeleton` and `EmptyState`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the results load, the tiles, the donut and the bar list render their own Skeleton, the summary holds Skeleton lines and the table shows Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: Nothing has been sent for analysis yet. The tiles read zero, the verdicts and sources keep their box with an EmptyState, and the Submissions card drops the filters and the table for one EmptyState that says what fills it.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.
